2027 Medicare · IRMAA
The $1 IRMAA cliff that costs high earners
2027 IRMAA is based on your
2025 tax return
Single · no surcharge up to
$109,000$112,000
Married jointly · up to

$1 OVER = FULL-YEAR SURCHARGE
IRMAA is an
extra surcharge added
onto both your
Part B premium
and your Part
D drug coverage
if your modified
adjusted gross income
from two years
ago,
meaning your 2025
tax return,
exceeded the threshold.
In 2027,
standard premiums apply
if your 2025
income was $112,000
or less for
single filers or
$224,000
or less for
married couples filing
jointly.
Remember,
IRMAA brackets are
steep cliffs,
not gradual slopes.
Landing even one
single dollar over
a bracket pushes
you into that
entire surcharge tier
for the full
year.
If IRMAA hits
you,
there's a way
to appeal it.
I walk through
it in my
full video,
on my channel.
